scientific_integrity: A self-contained proof establishes the parametrized bounded-morphism classification and image-rank multiplicities. A finite Python checker corroborates small instances. Classical Fibonacci, Lucas, central-trinomial and finite Esakia ingredients are acknowledged as prior mathematical knowledge; no independent review is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only crown posets of length m>=3; not general finite Esakia spaces.
Does not describe the endomorphism monoid multiplication or homomorphisms between different crown lengths.
The full texts of two older papers on unrestricted crown order-preserving maps were inaccessible in this comparison, leaving an explicit possible historical-equivalence risk.
Finite computational verification does not establish the theorem for all m.
title: Closed lazy walks classify endomorphisms and image ranks of crown Heyting algebras
